population_rules.rule: If 2 dragons are encountered, they are a mated pair if Adult or older, or siblings if Juvenile or younger.
If 3 or more dragons are encountered, they are a mated pair if Adult or older, plus offspring that are Juvenile or younger.
Roll treasure separately for each dragon based on its age.

reaction_or_pursuit_behavior.rule: Dragons tend to use breath weapon as their initial attack unless prevented.
On later rounds, dragons use breath weapon about 50% of the time.
Dragons may bargain or surrender to preserve their lives or obtain benefit.
Neutral dragons may or may not converse, depending on circumstances.
Lawful dragons are more likely to aid a good party or a party on a noble mission.
Chaotic dragons usually attempt to destroy a party on sight unless restraint offers gain.

attack_routine.name: breath_weapon
attack_routine.usage: default initial attack; about 50% of subsequent rounds

attack_routine.name: natural_attacks
attack_routine.usage: used when breath weapon is not employed

attack_effect.effect: All creatures in the area of effect are affected.
The acid stream burns through wooden or metal barriers and continues to full length beyond them.
The acid corrodes metal, wood, and cloth it touches.
Afflicted creatures lose 1d4 STR, 1d4 DEX, and 1d4 CON each day until cured.
If any affected ability score is reduced to 0, the creature dies.
attack_effect.duration: Until cured by cure disease from a 9th level or higher cleric; lost ability scores recover at 1 point per day after cure.

attack_effect.effect: For 1 round after the dragon breathes, the area of effect is partly obscured by vapors, steam, or dust.
attack_effect.follow_up: Attacks into or through the area suffer a -2 penalty.

attack_effect.effect: The bolt can melt lead, gold, copper, silver, or bronze.
If damage to an interposing barrier shatters or breaks through it, the bolt may continue beyond the barrier.
Ignites combustibles and damages objects in the area.
Can melt lead, gold, copper, silver, or bronze.
If damage to an interposing barrier shatters or breaks through it, the breath may continue beyond the barrier to attain full volume.

immunities.immunity: Immune to the effects of its own breath weapon.
Immune to the same kind of breath weapon from other dragons.
Immune to ordinary instances of a similar nature to its breath weapon.

resistances.resistance: Takes half damage from magical attacks similar to the nature of its breath weapon.

mobility_rules.rule: Sea dragons may lose the ability to fly, gain the ability to breathe underwater, and gain swim movement 240' (80').
Sea dragons may glide over the surface of water for 6 rounds.
Clutching Claws allows a dive attack with claws.

targeting_constraints.constraint: Cloud-shaped breath effects occupy an area 20' high, 40' long, and 40' wide.
Cone-shaped breath effects begin 2' wide and spread to a cone 90' long and 30' wide.
Line-shaped breath effects are 100' long and 5' wide throughout.
Clutching Claws only auto-grabs a creature smaller than the dragon if both claw attacks hit.
Grabbed humanoids, and any creatures with less than half the dragon's Hit Dice, can be carried off.
Tail Lash targets only creatures to the dragon's rear.

ability.name: special_ability_progression
ability.effect: Adult and Mature Adult dragons have 1 special ability; Old dragons have 1; Very Old and Ancient dragons have 2; Venerable dragons have 3.
ability.notes: Select powers appropriate to habitat and alignment, or create other suitable powers.

ability.name: clutching_claws
ability.effect: Deals double claw damage.
If both claw attacks hit a creature smaller than the dragon, the dragon automatically grabs the target.

ability.name: decapitating_bite
ability.trigger: Natural attack throw of 19-20 with bite

ability.name: elemental_aura
ability.effect: The dragon is surrounded by elemental energy appropriate to its breath weapon.
Characters within 5' take 1d4 damage per round.

ability.name: fear_aura
ability.trigger: When the dragon charges or flies overhead
ability.effect: Creatures with less than 1 Hit Dice flee in panic for 4d6 turns.

save.on_success: Avoid fear effect for listed category

ability.effect: Creatures with 1-3 Hit Dice that fail the save are paralyzed with fear.
Creatures with more than 3 Hit Dice that fail the save suffer -1 to attack throws.
ability.duration: Until the dragon is slain or passes out of sight and sound.

ability.name: gem_encrusted_hide
ability.effect: Gain +2 bonus to AC.
Movement is reduced by 30'.
AC bonus increases to +3 when the dragon becomes Very Old and +4 when the dragon becomes Venerable.

ability.name: horrific_stench
ability.effect: Nauseated characters suffer -3 to attack throws and damage rolls.
ability.duration: 1d4+4 rounds after leaving the dragon's vicinity.

ability.name: invulnerable
ability.effect: The dragon cannot be harmed by non-magical weapons.

ability.name: massive_size
ability.effect: Hit Dice increase by 3.
Claw damage, bite damage, and breath weapon damage increase commensurately.
ability.limitation: This special ability may be taken multiple times.
ability.notes: Venerable dragons attack for 3d6/3d6/6d8 if taken once, and 3d8/3d8/6d10 if taken twice.

ability.name: paralyzing_blows
ability.effect: Claw and bite attacks channel negative energy that causes paralysis for 3d4 turns.
ability.notes: Otherwise identical to a ghoul's paralysis.
ability.limitation: Only chaotic dragons may have this special ability.

ability.name: poisonous_blood
ability.trigger: Opponent successfully hits the dragon in melee

ability.name: polymorph_self
ability.effect: The dragon may change shape at will to any humanoid or animal form.
ability.limitation: Only dragons capable of casting spells may have this special ability.

ability.name: tail_lash
ability.effect: The dragon gains 1 additional melee attack each round with its tail.
Tail damage equals the dragon's bite damage.

ability.name: wing_claws
ability.effect: The dragon gains 2 additional melee attacks each round with the claws on its wings.
Wing claw damage equals the dragon's normal claw damage for its age category.

ability.name: speech_and_spellcasting
ability.effect: The dragon knows Common, Draconic, and 1 other language.
The dragon may cast arcane spells.
The dragon always knows the same number of arcane spells that it can cast per day.
Speaking dragons count as having 1 additional special ability for XP purposes.
ability.exception: Ancient and Venerable dragon XP values already include this adjustment.

habitat.rule: Dragon type, hide color, and breath weapon vary by habitat.
Sea dragons live almost exclusively in the water.
Sea dragons lair in underwater caverns and hoard treasure from sunken vessels.
Sea dragons are never found asleep above water.

social_structure.rule: Encountered groups are organized by mated pairs, siblings, and offspring according to age.

communication.rule: Chance of speech varies by age category.
All dragons that can speak know Common, Draconic, and 1 other language.

behavior_rules.rule: Sleeping chance when found on the ground or in lair varies by age category.
Older dragons are less likely to be caught asleep.
Dragons may be captured with incapacitating attacks or other methods.
An enslaved dragon becomes a henchman of the enslaving character but always desires freedom.

treasure_rules.rule: Roll treasure separately for each encountered dragon based on age.
Sea dragons typically hoard treasure from sunken vessels in underwater caverns.
A live dragon may be sold in a Class I or II market for 1,000 gp per total hit point.

treasure_and_rewards.xp_rule: Speaking dragons count as having 1 additional special ability for XP purposes; this is already factored into Ancient and Venerable XP values.

procedure.name: sleeping_dragon_encounter
procedure.condition: Dragon is encountered in its lair or otherwise on the ground.

steps.step: Roll chance asleep from the secondary dragon attributes table.
If asleep, opponents may attack for 1 round with +2 to all attack throws.
Thieves may backstab a sleeping dragon.
After that round, the dragon is roused whether or not any attacks hit.
Combat proceeds normally beginning on round 2.

procedure.outcome: Sleeping dragons grant one round of advantageous attacks before awakening.

procedure.name: determine_speech_and_spellcasting

steps.step: Roll or read chance of speech from the secondary dragon attributes table.
If the dragon can speak, grant Common, Draconic, and 1 other language.
Assign spells per day by spell level from the secondary dragon attributes table.
The dragon knows the same number of spells as it can cast per day.
Count the dragon as having 1 additional special ability for XP unless it is Ancient or Venerable, whose listed XP already includes this.

procedure.outcome: Speech-capable dragons also become arcane spellcasters.

procedure.name: capture_enslavement_or_sale

steps.step: Characters may attempt to capture a dragon with incapacitating attacks or other devised methods.
If successfully captured, characters may enslave the dragon or sell it.
An enslaved dragon becomes a henchman of the enslaving character.
Whenever an enslaved dragon has an opportunity to escape or betray its master, it must make a Henchman Loyalty roll.

procedure.follow_up: Apply the dragon's normal morale bonus as a penalty to the Henchman Loyalty roll.
procedure.outcome: A live dragon sold in a Class I or II market brings 1,000 gp per total hit point.

procedure.name: multiple_dragon_encounter_generation

steps.step: If 2 dragons are encountered, determine whether they are Adult or older or Juvenile or younger.
Adult or older pairs are mated pairs; Juvenile or younger pairs are siblings.
If 3 or more dragons are encountered, adults or older form a mated pair and the remainder are offspring that are Juvenile or younger.
Roll treasure separately for each dragon based on age.

procedure.outcome: Multi-dragon encounters follow family-group composition by age.

references.notation_reference: Printed Hit Dice asterisks correspond to expanded special abilities and spellcasting rules described in the entry.

confidence_notes.note: The secondary dragon attributes table header is malformed in the source transcription. I interpreted the trailing numeric columns as spells per day by spell level 1-5 because that best fits the row data and the accompanying speech-and-spellcasting text.

The habitat table lists Sea dragon and White dragon breath weapons as "90' long, 30' wide, cloud," which conflicts with the general cloud-breath area rule given earlier. I preserved the printed habitat-table values and also preserved the general cloud-shape rule separately.
